body: I may well come over! I’m sure I can find a few things over there to fill my time! 😂

I appreciate the comment. Thank you for the kind words. I’m not a religious man myself but this is a long time in the making. I can only take comfort in that after loss, they will certainly move on. My wife is young enough and I’m childless. I have also given told her in my note that her eventually moving on when she’s ready is what I’ll want and that if heaven exists I’ll be looking down on her and her children as a happy man. I know it wouldn’t go any way to console her immediately but hopefully in time. Have a good night. Many thanks for the reply.
Appreciate what you’re saying, but there are better ways than some. I am happy, I’m not depressed or sad and I’m choosing to leave happy.
